queries_run: Morgan Stanley CET1 ratio regulatory requirement 2026 stress capital buffer
Basel III endgame re-proposal 2026 capital rule big banks
Morgan Stanley regulatory capital buffer 2026 GSIB surcharge

findings.excerpt: The Federal Reserve said on February 4, 2026 that Morgan Stanley remains subject to its current 4.3% SCB until October 1, 2027

findings.claim: 2026-03-19 三項資本提案取代 2023 年 Basel III Endgame；機關估計最大 GSIB 的 CET1 要求下降約 4.8%，Fed 估 GSIB 附加費平均降約 40bp；尚無最終規則。
findings.source: Fed/OCC/FDIC 2026-03-19 proposals，經 Basel III Endgame 2026 摘要整理（learnsignal／Senate letter）
findings.excerpt: The agencies project Common Equity Tier 1 requirements falling about 4.8 percent for the largest global systemically important banks. The Fed estimates a GSIB surcharge cut averaging 40 basis points.

findings.claim: 2026-06-18 參議院民主黨議員要求 Bowman、Gould、Hill 撤回三項資本提案，主張重新提出更嚴規則；屬提案翻轉風險。
findings.source: Senate Banking Committee, letter to financial regulators re Basel III proposal
findings.excerpt: On June 18, 2026, Senate Democrats asked Bowman, Comptroller Gould, and FDIC Chairman Hill to withdraw all three proposals.

findings.claim: MS 在 2026-06-18 意見信支持提案核心設計，促請 2026 年內定案，修訂資本標準一般於 2028-01-01 生效；與 Fed 幕僚會談聚焦短期批發資金指標與實施時程。GSIB 提案把附加費級距由 0.5pp 改為 0.1pp。
findings.source: Fed 公開會議紀錄 morgan-stanley-meeting-20260707 及 MS 意見信（經搜尋摘要）
findings.excerpt: it supported the core design of these proposals and urged the agencies to finalize standards in 2026, with revised capital standards generally taking effect on January 1, 2028.

financial_regulatory_capital_rules.note: excerpt 皆取自搜尋工具回傳之摘要文字，非直接讀頁；最終規則狀態未找到；現行 GSIB 附加費 10-Q 表列 3.0%（同一摘要）。
